cases.label: vixie-artefact
cases.note: Leading '*' sets DOM_STAR, forcing AND; '*/100' contributes only day 1; '1-7' bounds the window to the first week.

cases.label: reject-step
cases.note: Dialects that reject a step larger than the field range.

expectation.note: The community's canonical workaround depends on a parser bug in the rule's own reference implementation.

normative_evidence.quote: 0 0 */100,1-7 * MON yields 'first Monday of the month'

rationale: Strongest single piece of evidence that cron's day semantics are an implementation artefact rather than a rule: the idiom is only correct if the bug is present.
title: The '*/100,1-7 * MON' first-Monday idiom weaponising the artefact
